## What you are trying to do

Describe the actual task you are stuck on, not the feature you have in mind for
it. The underlying problem is the useful part.

## What you do today

How you work around it now, if you do. Say so if there is no workaround.

## What you would want instead

Sketch the behavior you want. Rough is fine.

## Anything else

Related issues, prior art in other tools, or constraints we should know about.
